from pathlib import Path
import re

lib = Path("crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/lib.rs")
text = lib.read_text()
old = "pub mod fwcfg;\npub mod hda;"
new = "pub mod fwcfg;\nmod guest_memory;\npub mod hda;"
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("lib.rs module anchor changed")
lib.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))

datapath = Path("crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/virtio_net/datapath.rs")
text = datapath.read_text()
import_anchor = "use crate::fwcfg::GuestMemoryMut;\n"
if text.count(import_anchor) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("datapath import anchor changed")
text = text.replace(
    import_anchor,
    import_anchor + "use crate::guest_memory::append_guest_bytes_bounded;\n",
    1,
)
old = """            let start = packet.len();
            let Some(end) = start.checked_add(desc.len as usize) else {
                return false;
            };
            if end > MAX_TX_PACKET_LEN {
                return false;
            }
            let Some(bytes) = mem.read_bytes(desc.addr, desc.len as usize) else {
                return false;
            };
            packet.extend_from_slice(&bytes);"""
new = """            if !append_guest_bytes_bounded(
                mem,
                desc.addr,
                desc.len as usize,
                MAX_TX_PACKET_LEN,
                packet,
            ) {
                return false;
            }"""
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("virtio-net TX gather anchor changed")
datapath.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))

tests_mod = Path("crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/virtio_net/tests/mod.rs")
text = tests_mod.read_text()
anchor = "mod queue_pending;\n"
if text.count(anchor) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("virtio-net tests module anchor changed")
tests_mod.write_text(text.replace(anchor, "mod queue_pending;\nmod read_into;\n", 1))

Path("crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/guest_memory.rs").write_text(
    """//! Allocation-free helpers for bounded reads from guest RAM into reusable buffers.

use crate::fwcfg::GuestMemoryMut;

pub(crate) fn append_guest_bytes_bounded(
    mem: &dyn GuestMemoryMut,
    gpa: u64,
    len: usize,
    max_len: usize,
    out: &mut Vec<u8>,
) -> bool {
    let start = out.len();
    let Some(end) = start.checked_add(len) else {
        return false;
    };
    if end > max_len {
        return false;
    }
    out.resize(end, 0);
    if mem.read_into(gpa, &mut out[start..end]) {
        return true;
    }
    out.truncate(start);
    false
}
"""
)

Path("crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/virtio_net/tests/read_into.rs").write_text(
    """//! Regression for allocation-free TX descriptor gathering.

use super::super::*;
use crate::fwcfg::GuestMemoryMut;
use std::cell::Cell;

const DESC_GPA: u64 = 0x100;
const PAYLOAD_GPA: u64 = 0x200;

struct ReadIntoOnlyMem {
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
    read_into_calls: Cell<usize>,
}

impl ReadIntoOnlyMem {
    fn new(payload: &[u8]) -> Self {
        let mut bytes = vec![0u8; 0x400];
        let desc = DESC_GPA as usize;
        bytes[desc..desc + 8].copy_from_slice(&PAYLOAD_GPA.to_le_bytes());
        bytes[desc + 8..desc + 12]
            .copy_from_slice(&u32::try_from(payload.len()).unwrap().to_le_bytes());
        let payload_start = PAYLOAD_GPA as usize;
        bytes[payload_start..payload_start + payload.len()].copy_from_slice(payload);
        Self {
            bytes,
            read_into_calls: Cell::new(0),
        }
    }
}

impl GuestMemoryMut for ReadIntoOnlyMem {
    fn write_bytes(&mut self, _gpa: u64, _data: &[u8]) -> bool {
        panic!("TX gather must not write guest memory")
    }

    fn read_bytes(&self, _gpa: u64, _len: usize) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        panic!("TX gather must not allocate through read_bytes")
    }

    fn read_into(&self, gpa: u64, dst: &mut [u8]) -> bool {
        let Ok(start) = usize::try_from(gpa) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(end) = start.checked_add(dst.len()) else {
            return false;
        };
        let Some(src) = self.bytes.get(start..end) else {
            return false;
        };
        dst.copy_from_slice(src);
        self.read_into_calls
            .set(self.read_into_calls.get().saturating_add(1));
        true
    }
}

#[test]
fn tx_chain_reads_descriptors_and_payload_without_read_bytes() {
    let mut payload = vec![0u8; VIRTIO_NET_HDR_LEN];
    payload.extend_from_slice(b"ping");
    let mem = ReadIntoOnlyMem::new(&payload);
    let mut queue = VirtioNetQueue::new(0);
    queue.size = 1;
    queue.ready = true;
    queue.desc = DESC_GPA;
    let mut descs = Vec::with_capacity(1);
    let mut packet = vec![0xff; payload.len()];

    assert!(VirtioNet::<LoopbackTestBackend>::tx_frame_from_chain_into(
        &mem,
        &queue,
        0,
        &mut descs,
        &mut packet,
    ));
    assert_eq!(packet, payload);
    assert_eq!(mem.read_into_calls.get(), 2);
}
"""
)

simple_decl = re.compile(
    r"^\s*((pub\s+)?(mod|use)\s+[^;{]*;|#\[path\s*=.*\])\s*$"
)


def budget_loc(path: Path) -> int:
    loc = 0
    header = True
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        if header and re.match(r"^\s*//!", line):
            continue
        if header and not line.strip():
            header = False
            continue
        header = False
        if simple_decl.match(line):
            continue
        loc += 1
    return loc


budgets = Path("scripts/refactor-budgets.tsv")
rows = budgets.read_text().splitlines()
existing = {
    "crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/virtio_net/datapath.rs": budget_loc(datapath),
}
rewritten = []
for row in rows:
    key = row.split("\t", 1)[0]
    if key in existing:
        rewritten.append(f"{key}\t{existing.pop(key)}\t0")
    else:
        rewritten.append(row)
if existing:
    raise SystemExit(f"missing existing budget rows: {sorted(existing)}")
for path in [
    Path("crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/guest_memory.rs"),
    Path("crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/virtio_net/tests/read_into.rs"),
]:
    rewritten.append(f"{path.as_posix()}\t{budget_loc(path)}\t0")
budgets.write_text("\n".join(rewritten) + "\n")
